title: Dia Browser button
description: The site's pills: a pure-black CTA that swells 2% and lifts onto a deep, soft shadow with a faint inner highlight on hover; a quiet grey-fill pill whose trailing arrow nudges 6px right; and a near-white outlined pill for the header. All 0.3s ease.
notes: tone solid = primary (black in the faithful theme), soft = secondary fill, outline = popover with a hairline
size lg is the 56px waitlist CTA (48px on phones); md is 44px; sm is the 35px link pill
